summary.en: A source frame is pulled into the gate with a line; the strip runs out of the gate; the name settles on the light box, the address types; the pencil underlines it on the last bar.
summary.zh: 一格来源画面被拉进片门，下面一行字；胶片跑出片门；名字落在灯箱上，网址逐字打出；最后一小节蜡笔在下面画线。

fits: The close of a strip film.
notFor: A logo card; a QR end card.

intent.en: The reel leaves; what is left on the light box is the name and where to get it.
intent.zh: 胶片走了，灯箱上留下的是名字和去哪里获取。

content.en: A source frame (the repository or download page), a line (≤ 6 words / 16 字), the name, the address.
content.zh: 一格来源画面（仓库页或下载页）、一行（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）、名字、网址。

en: Hold the address at least 3 s.

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
